summary: Grand Canyon Education, Inc. (GCE) filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting entry into a $100 million five-year senior secured revolving credit facility on September 28, 2026, with Zions Bancorporation as administrative agent. The facility includes a $10 million letter-of-credit sublimit, pricing at Term SOFR plus 150-200 basis points, an accordion up to $200 million, and matures in 2031. Proceeds are intended primarily for stock repurchases under a board-approved program and general corporate purposes. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
